pricing_framing: De-emphasize the percentage discount (claimed 'Up To 38% Off' cannot be verified — no original prices captured). Instead, position as 'competitive intro pricing for first-time clients in Midtown Manhattan.' The $62.10 base tier is comparable to or slightly below the validated $65–$85 market range for basic haircut and style services. For the higher-tier balayage options ($197.10 and $202.50), no high-confidence competitor price matches exist, so lead with service description and convenience rather than unverifiable savings claims. Frame as: 'From $62.10 — competitive rates for Midtown, first-time client pricing.'
executive_summary: The page scores 4.9/10 overall with critical trust (3/10) and value communication (4/10) gaps. The #1 issue: the highlights section shows only 2 services but 3 pricing tiers exist — customers buying the $197.10 balayage option see no confirmation in 'What You Get.' Add the missing tier, define hair length upcharges (flagged as hidden-cost risk), and reframe the marginal $3–$18 savings honestly as competitive intro pricing. These changes could reduce purchase abandonment by 20–30%.
